seasons.name: Batwheels
seasons.plot: Bam, Redbird, Bibi, Batwing, and Buff are thrust into hilarious hijinks and draw-dropping action as they learn important lessons about teamwork, friendship, and so much more while helping Batman, Robin, and Batgirl defend Gotham.

translations.value: Batwheels

episodes.name: L'origine segreta delle Batwheels
episodes.plot: Nella Batcaverna servono rinforzi per una minaccia incombente, quindi Batcomputer attiva tutti i Batveicoli con un aggiornamento intelligente... e nascono le Batwheels!

episodes.name: Fermate quella paperomobile! / Il migliore amico di Buff
episodes.plot: Bam deve imparare a guidare la squadra quando insieme affrontano un Papero turboaccelerato. Buff fa amicizia con il veicolo di un supercattivo, che risulta essere molto simpatico!

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. These stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

translations.value: Episodio 1

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

translations.value: Episodio 2

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task.

translations.value: Episodio 3

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: When Redbird takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking, Red enlists Bam to help him make a daring rescue.

translations.value: Episodio 4

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: When Bam is covered in Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage.

translations.value: Episodio 5

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he's tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

translations.value: Episodio 6

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Batwing and Goldie secretly decide to participate in the Gotham Air-Show, but when Batman needs their help, they must choose between winning the competition and their responsibilities to fight crime.

translations.value: Episodio 7

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He's too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.

translations.value: Episodio 8

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

translations.value: Episodio 9

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

translations.value: Episodio 10
